issue.title: [Bug] find_files fails to match any files when pattern begins with ./

steps: Create src/example.ts containing export const value = 1; and package.json containing {"name":"local-fixture","version":"1.0.0"}. Call find_files with pattern="./src/**/*.ts", then pattern="src/**/*.ts", and show both results.
expected: A leading ./ has the same relative glob meaning as the equivalent normalized pattern.
defect: find_files returns no match for ./src/**/*.ts while the pattern without ./ finds src/example.ts.

fault location.explanation: Candidate paths are normalized relative names without ./, but the glob regex is anchored to a pattern that still starts with ./, so it cannot match. 1db5046f normalizes the pattern.
